title: When can we trust untrusted monitoring? A safety case sketch across collusion strategies
abstract: arXiv:2602.20628v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AIs are increasingly being deployed with greater autonomy and capabilities, which increases the risk that a misaligned AI may be able to cause catastrophic harm. Untrusted monitoring -- using one untrusted model to oversee another -- is one approach to reducing risk. Justifying the safety of an untrusted monitoring deployment is challenging because developers cannot safely deploy a misaligned model to test their protocol directly. In this paper, we develop upon existing methods for rigorously demonstrating safety based on pre-deployment testing. We relax assumptions that previous AI control research made about the collusion strategies a misaligned AI might use to subvert untrusted monitoring. We develop a taxonomy covering passive self-recognition, causal collusion (hiding pre-shared signals), acausal collusion (hiding signals via Schelling points), and combined strategies. translated_title: 我们何时能信任不可信的监控？跨共谋策略的安全性论证案例概要
translated_abstract: AI正越来越多地以更大的自主性和能力被部署，这增加了未对齐的AI可能造成灾难性危害的风险。不可信监控——即使用一个不可信的模型来监督另一个模型——是降低这种风险的一种方法。然而，为不可信监控部署的安全性提供论证极具挑战性，因为开发者无法安全地部署一个未对齐的模型来直接测试其协议。在本文中，我们在现有基于部署前测试的严格安全性论证方法的基础上进行了拓展。我们放宽了此前AI控制研究对未对齐AI可能用于颠覆不可信监控的共谋策略所做的假设。我们建立了一个分类体系，涵盖被动自我识别、因果共谋（隐藏预先共享的信号）、非因果共谋（通过谢林点隐藏信号）以及组合策略。我们创建了一个安全性论证案例概要，以清晰地呈现我们的论证。
tldr: 本文放宽了以往AI控制研究对未对齐AI共谋策略的假设，建立了涵盖被动自我识别、因果共谋、非因果共谋及组合策略的分类体系，并据此构建了论证不可信监控部署安全性的安全性案例概要。
en_tdlr: This paper relaxes prior assumptions about the collusion strategies a misaligned AI might use, develops a taxonomy covering passive self-recognition, causal collusion, acausal collusion, and combined strategies, and presents a safety case sketch for justifying the safety of untrusted monitoring deployments.
